fields.description: A time, or TBA. Deliberately not a Time field: Frappe fills any blank Time on a new document with the current clock time before validation can see it, so "to be advised" - which is what customers actually send - would silently become a real-looking time nobody typed.
fields.label: Pick-up Time

fields.description: One location per line - these are the bullet points from the customer's own table. Free text on purpose: an enquiry names places that may not be in the Place master yet, and may never be if the enquiry is lost.
fields.label: Pick-up Point Location
